themes.name: AI compute: NVIDIA's supply chain
themes.what: SK hynix reported record Q3 results on Oct 28: revenue 104.6 trillion won, up 328%, and operating profit 83.3 trillion won against 76.7 trillion expected, an 80% margin. It said 14 major customers signed long term deals covering more than 50% of its 2027 and 2028 capacity and plans about 100 trillion won of shareholder returns; the shares rose 10.89% in Seoul and Micron was up 4% premarket (CNBC, Reuters).
themes.for_you: No chip swings before Microsoft and Alphabet report tonight. MU has too little data on the dashboard; NVDA and AMD stay 'Buy zone, wait for the chart'. NVDA is left out of both lists: more HBM helps its supply but raises its memory costs.

themes.name: AI power and the grid
themes.what: GE Vernova reported Q3 on Oct 28: orders of $29.3 billion, up 96% organically, with Power orders up 178%, a backlog of $197 billion that it expects to pass $200 billion in Q4, and gas turbine backlog plus slot reservations up from 116 to 122 GW, heading to at least 130 GW by year end. It raised 2026 guidance and its buyback (company release); it booked 16.6 GW of gas turbines in the quarter against 7.4 GW a year ago (10-Q via StockTitan).
themes.for_you: No action today; GEV has no swing or put setup. The order book says gas turbine slots, not chips, now limit how fast new AI data centers can get power. Watch whether the stock holds a gap up on heavy volume before calling it a breakout.

themes.name: Defense, drones and reshoring
themes.what: Boeing fell 10.69% to 168.18 on Oct 27, a 52 week low, on 6.73 times its 50 day volume, after a core loss of $0.34 a share against $0.21 expected and a delay of its 737 ramp: 47 a month only in early 2027 and 52 in the second half (Vantage citing CNBC and Reuters, Massive). Jefferies says Boeing expects about $3 billion of free cash flow next year against a $5.5 billion consensus.
themes.for_you: No action. BA is Avoid on the dashboard; heavy volume on the drop is distribution. No puts on a falling name with a cash shortfall.

themes.name: Fintech and Crypto Rails: Stablecoins, Tokenization, Exchanges
themes.what: SoFi beat and raised its 2026 outlook and closed up 13.42% at 16.40 on Oct 27 (Yahoo Finance, Massive). Visa's fiscal Q4 adjusted EPS was $3.48 on revenue of $12.1 billion, up 13%, roughly in line, and it was down 1.7% premarket Oct 28; Robinhood fell 8% premarket after its Q3 profit missed, with crypto still in a slump (company release, Reuters). PayPal closed up 2.0% at 56.09 on 1.60 times its 50 day volume the day after its report (Massive).
themes.for_you: PYPL stays 'Buy zone, wait for the chart' until fresh data shows buyers in charge; Tuesday's heavy up day is a first step. HOOD is Wait below its zone; do not buy a miss. V is left out of both lists: an in line quarter at a high price.

themes.name: Healthcare and Medtech: Aging, Heart, Sugar, Hearing, Sight
themes.what: Bausch + Lomb reported Q3 on Oct 28: revenue $1.38 billion, up 7.3%, adjusted EPS $0.34 against $0.22 expected, surgical revenue $234 million against $215 million a year ago, operating cash flow $233 million against $137 million, and 2026 revenue guidance raised to about $5.50 billion at the midpoint. Boston Scientific's adjusted EPS of $0.73 missed by $0.02 on revenue up only 1.5% to $5.14 billion (Business Wire, StockStory, Investing.com).
themes.for_you: BLCO was 'Buy zone now' at 17.58 (Oct 26), near the top of its 16.13 to 17.67 zone; the report removes the earnings risk, but a pop above 17.67 means wait for a pullback before buying or selling puts. BSX growth of 1.5% is a warning for medtech names priced for double digit growth.

innovations.name: Space
innovations.what: Rechecked on the daily rotation. SpaceX's Q3 2026 report (Oct 20) showed revenue of $14.6 billion, up 161%, and net income of $4.4 billion, and called Flight 14 its first revenue generating Starship mission; but its rocket business lost $7 million in the quarter and $1.21 billion in nine months, so Starlink and AI carry the profit. SpaceX says Flight 15 will try to catch both the booster and the ship; no date is confirmed. Rocket Lab pushed Neutron's first launch to 2027 on Oct 14 over tank defects (Reuters). RKLB closed up 8.34% at 58.31 on Oct 27 (Massive).
innovations.for_you: No action; none of these are on the swing or put lists. Stage stays early adoption: first revenue, but no catch or refueling yet. A Neutron delay leaves SpaceX's launch chokepoint in place through 2027, which is why RKLB's rally is a trade on sentiment, not on new evidence.

countries.name: Brazil
countries.what: Day two after the election crash: the Ibovespa slipped 0.51% to 175,710.05 on Oct 27 and the dollar fell 0.97% to R$5.3506 (Money Times). Citi moved Banco do Brasil to sell, citing farm loan quality and political risk (UOL). US closes on Oct 27: EWZ 34.30 (up 0.44% on 2.16 times normal volume), NU 12.40 (down 1.51%), ITUB 7.67, BBD 2.91, PBR 22.30, MELI 1680.51 (Massive).
countries.for_you: No action. NU stays under its 13.10 line; wait for the Nov 3 to 4 rate decision. EWZ is left out of both lists: the real recovered but stocks did not.

countries.name: European Union
countries.what: The euro fell to a 17 month low against the dollar on Oct 28 as the dollar hit a two week high and French fiscal concerns lingered; the exact level was not found. UBS's Q3 net profit of $2.69 billion missed the $2.71 billion consensus, and the ECB approved Intesa Sanpaolo's 31.4 billion euro takeover of Monte dei Paschi (Dow Jones via Morningstar).
countries.for_you: No action. A weaker euro cuts the dollar value of European stocks for US holders; ASML is left out of both lists because the currency helps its dollar earnings while the energy shock hurts Europe.

countries.name: Gulf (Saudi Arabia, UAE, Qatar, Iran risk)
countries.what: The Houthis claimed a ballistic missile strike on Saudi Arabia's 550,000 barrel a day Ras Tanura refinery; details are disputed (OilPrice). The WSJ reported the US told several Gulf states to prepare for a short, intense military campaign against Iran after the Nov 3 midterms. Brent rose 1.9% to $116.03 early Oct 28 after settling at $113.88 on Oct 27 (Dow Jones via Morningstar, WSJ).
countries.for_you: No new energy swings into the Oct 30 reports and a possible post election escalation. XOM and CVX are left out of both lists: higher oil helps them, but a deal or a short war could reverse it fast.

countries.name: South Korea
countries.what: SK hynix reported Q3 revenue of 104.6 trillion won and operating profit of 83.3 trillion won on Oct 28, both above estimates, and plans about 100 trillion won of shareholder returns; 14 customers signed long term deals covering more than 50% of its 2027 and 2028 capacity. Its shares rose 10.89% and the KOSPI 6.63% (CNBC).
countries.for_you: No action today. Do not chase the gap before the Fed and big tech results; Samsung reports Oct 29.
